notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are inside the Other Governmental Funds column), business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4-5); interfund transfers of 120,635 are eliminated in that column so transfers_in/out are null. Roll: 3,248,627 + 6,842,957 - 6,042,972 = 4,048,612. Balance sheet uses the government-wide modified cash basis statement p3 (no liabilities printed; total_liabilities null). Detail: General Fund taken from the budget-and-actual schedule (p10-13), which is more complete than the General Fund components combining schedule (p7-9; it omits Title I 77,421 and its disbursements are before reclassification), so the combining page is not duplicated; Depreciation, Employee Benefit and other funds from their own budget schedules. Lines with a budget but no 2025 actual (e.g. 9000 Non-program expenditures 2,907,126, 4310 REAP, EBF Miscellaneous disbursements) are omitted. Hidden transfer: General Fund spending lines include 366,204 (O&M 328,204 + transportation 38,000) that the combining schedule (p8) reclassifies as transfer to the Depreciation Fund (receives 366,204, p14); recorded as two contra expenditure lines plus two other financing lines, so General Fund expenditure detail lines no longer add to the printed 5,638,976 total (that total also includes the 120,635 transfers line printed in disbursements). Student activities: only the one-line Activities Fund budget schedule is in the trimmed PDF. School Nutrition fund transfer in 46,216 + Activities transfer in 74,419 = 120,635 General Fund transfer out (matches). Read pages 1-20 of 20
